issues.description: Close message type 'Close' does not match Deepgram's required 'CloseStream'
issues.detail: _CLOSE_MSG is json.dumps({"type": "Close"}), but the PR description and Deepgram's Speak v1 API specify {"type": "CloseStream"}. The server will likely ignore the unknown type, making this fix a silent no-op and leaving the audio-truncation bug unaddressed. Align the string with the documented control message.

issues.description: Single ws.receive() may consume a final audio frame instead of the close acknowledgment
issues.detail: After Flush+Close, Deepgram can still emit buffered audio binary frames before any close ack. One ws.receive() pops whichever message arrives first and discards it, potentially truncating the very audio the fix is meant to preserve. Loop draining until a CLOSE/CLOSED frame or timeout, forwarding audio to the emitter.

issues.description: send_str on an already-closed WebSocket raises and is swallowed by the broad except
issues.detail: _close_ws can run during error/teardown paths where the socket is already closing. send_str then raises ConnectionResetError/ClientError, the broad except logs a warning, and both Flush and Close are silently lost. Check ws.closed before sending so partial graceful shutdown is still attempted and noisy warnings on normal error paths are avoided.

issues.description: Broad except Exception hides real errors during shutdown
issues.detail: The except Exception around send/receive will swallow legitimate bugs (AttributeError, unexpected client errors) and downgrade them to a warning. Narrow to (aiohttp.ClientError, ConnectionError, asyncio.TimeoutError, OSError) and include exc_info=True so genuine failures surface in logs.

issues.description: Hardcoded 1s wait adds latency to every stream teardown
issues.detail: Every _close_ws now blocks up to a full second on receive(). For rapid-turn conversational agents this compounds across sessions and slows test runs. Consider a shorter default (e.g. 250ms) or exposing the timeout via conn_options so it can be tuned per deployment.

issues.description: f-string in logger.warning bypasses lazy formatting and drops traceback
issues.detail: logger.warning(f"...{e}") evaluates the message regardless of log level and loses exc_info. Use logger.warning("...: %s", e) or logger.exception(...) so the codebase stays consistent and shutdown failures retain tracebacks for debugging.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the fix has correct intent but ships with a likely correctness bug: _CLOSE_MSG is serialized as {"type": "Close"} while the PR description and Deepgram Speak v1 API specify {"type": "CloseStream"}, almost certainly making the patch a silent no-op. The single ws.receive() with a 1s timeout is also flagged unanimously as inadequate — it may consume and discard a trailing audio frame rather than waiting for the close acknowledgment, partially worsening the truncation it aims to fix. Secondary concerns: send_str on an already-closed socket is swallowed by an overly broad except, the 1s timeout is hardcoded on the teardown hot path, and the warning uses eager f-string formatting without exc_info. Verify the exact control-message string and switch to a drain loop before merging.
